meta.title: LinkFlow API
meta.description: Create and manage short links and QR codes, and read the click analytics LinkFlow already records.

scopes.label: Read links
scopes.description: List links and retrieve a single link.

scopes.label: Read QR codes
scopes.description: List QR codes and retrieve a single QR code.

scopes.label: Read analytics
scopes.description: Read the analytics overview, per-link click series and QR analytics.

errorCatalog.message: Varies by field, for example: originalUrl must be a valid http or https URL.
errorCatalog.meaning: A path parameter, query parameter or request body field failed validation.
errorCatalog.handling: Show the message next to the offending field. Do not retry until the input is corrected.

errorCatalog.message: Request body must be valid JSON.
errorCatalog.meaning: The request body could not be parsed as JSON.
errorCatalog.handling: Serialize the body with a JSON encoder and set Content-Type: application/json.

errorCatalog.message: An API key is required in the X-API-Key header.
errorCatalog.meaning: No X-API-Key header was sent, or it was blank.
errorCatalog.handling: Read the key from a server-side secret store and send it in the X-API-Key header.

errorCatalog.meaning: The key is malformed, unknown, or its secret does not match.
errorCatalog.handling: Check for truncation or a test/live mix-up. Never retry a malformed key in a loop.

errorCatalog.message: This API key has been revoked.
errorCatalog.meaning: The key authenticated successfully but has been revoked in the dashboard.
errorCatalog.handling: Stop using the key. Create a replacement in the Developer Dashboard.

errorCatalog.meaning: The key authenticated successfully but its expiresAt timestamp is in the past.
errorCatalog.handling: Rotate the key or create one with a new expiration date.

errorCatalog.message: This API key lacks the required scope: links:write.
errorCatalog.meaning: The key authenticated but was not granted the scope this endpoint requires.
errorCatalog.handling: Create a new key with the required scope, or call an endpoint the current key is allowed to use.

errorCatalog.message: The developer account for this API key no longer exists.
errorCatalog.meaning: The owning LinkFlow account could not be resolved. This should only happen after account deletion.
errorCatalog.handling: Stop using the key and contact support if the account should still exist.

errorCatalog.meaning: The resource does not exist, belongs to another developer, or the path is not a public API route.
errorCatalog.handling: Treat as not found. Do not retry automatically; ownership is never disclosed.

errorCatalog.message: Method not allowed for this endpoint.
errorCatalog.meaning: The path exists but does not support this HTTP method. The Allow response header lists supported methods.
errorCatalog.handling: Use one of the methods listed in the Allow header.

errorCatalog.message: That customAlias is already in use.
errorCatalog.meaning: The requested customAlias is already used by an existing short link.
errorCatalog.handling: Choose another alias or omit customAlias to let LinkFlow generate one.

errorCatalog.message: Request body must not exceed 65536 bytes.
errorCatalog.meaning: The JSON body is larger than the 64 KiB public API limit.
errorCatalog.handling: Send a smaller body. QR images are generated from a URL, not uploaded.

errorCatalog.meaning: The server failed while handling an authenticated request.
errorCatalog.handling: Retry with exponential backoff for idempotent reads. Report persistent failures with the request timestamp.

errorCatalog.message: Developer API key hashing is not configured on this server.
errorCatalog.meaning: The server is missing a valid API_KEY_HASH_SECRET.
errorCatalog.handling: Server configuration issue. Contact the operator; do not retry in a tight loop.

errorCatalog.message: Developer API key persistence is not configured on this server.
errorCatalog.meaning: The server has no usable PostgreSQL connection for API keys.
errorCatalog.handling: Server configuration issue. Contact the operator; do not retry in a tight loop.

endpoints.name: List links
endpoints.summary: List the short links owned by the API key.
endpoints.description: Returns the authenticated developer's short links, newest first. Pagination is offset-based. The total field is the full number of links owned by the developer, not just the current page.

queryParams.name: limit
queryParams.description: Maximum number of links to return.

queryParams.name: offset
queryParams.description: Number of links to skip before returning results.

notes: Ordering is newest first by creation time.
A limit above 100 or an offset above 100000 is rejected with VALIDATION_ERROR.

endpoints.name: Create a link
endpoints.summary: Create a short link owned by the API key.
endpoints.description: Creates a short link. Ownership is always taken from the API key; any userId or user_id in the body is ignored. If customAlias is omitted, LinkFlow generates a short code.

originalUrl.description: Absolute http or https destination URL.

title.description: Optional human-readable label. Blank strings are treated as omitted.

customAlias.description: Optional Base62 short code. Must be globally unique and contain only A-Z, a-z and 0-9.

notes: originalUrl must be an absolute http or https URL; javascript:, file: and relative URLs are rejected.
customAlias is unique across LinkFlow, not just within your account.
Link expiration can be set from the LinkFlow app, but this endpoint does not accept an expiresAt field.

endpoints.name: Retrieve a link
endpoints.summary: Retrieve one short link by id.
endpoints.description: Returns one link owned by the authenticated developer. Another developer's link is reported as 404, never 403.

pathParams.name: id
pathParams.description: Link id returned by the create or list endpoint.

notes: A malformed id returns 400 VALIDATION_ERROR; a well-formed id that does not exist returns 404 NOT_FOUND.

endpoints.name: Delete a link
endpoints.summary: Delete one short link by id.
endpoints.description: Permanently deletes a link owned by the authenticated developer. The response contains only the deleted id.

success.description: The id of the deleted link.

notes: Deletion is permanent. A QR code attached to this link keeps its stored targetUrl but its analytics stops resolving the link.

endpoints.name: Link click analytics
endpoints.summary: Read the click series for one short link.
endpoints.description: Returns the link, its all-time click count and a zero-filled daily click series for the requested window. totalClicks is the link's lifetime count; daily covers only the requested number of days.

queryParams.name: days
queryParams.description: Number of days in the daily series, ending today.

success.description: Link metadata plus a daily click series.

notes: daily always contains exactly `days` entries, oldest first, with zero-filled gaps.
Dates are UTC calendar days in YYYY-MM-DD form.
Clicks are redirects through LinkFlow. They are not unique visitors and not QR scans.

endpoints.name: List QR codes
endpoints.summary: List the QR codes owned by the API key.
endpoints.description: Returns QR metadata, newest first, with the same offset pagination as links. Image data is not included in list responses.

queryParams.name: limit
queryParams.description: Maximum number of QR codes to return.

queryParams.name: offset
queryParams.description: Number of QR codes to skip.

notes: List responses contain metadata only. Use the retrieve endpoint to render an image.

endpoints.name: Create a QR code
endpoints.summary: Generate a QR code image for a URL or an owned short link.
endpoints.description: Creates QR metadata and returns a PNG data URI. Provide targetUrl, or provide linkId to encode that short link's public URL. If both are supplied, targetUrl wins.

targetUrl.description: Absolute http or https URL to encode.

linkId.description: An owned link id. Its public short URL is encoded when targetUrl is omitted.

title.description: Optional label. Defaults to "QR Code" when stored.

success.description: QR metadata plus a rendered PNG data URI.

notes: Image customisation applies to this response only. The database stores QR metadata, not image options, so a later retrieve renders the defaults.
Images are returned as data URIs; LinkFlow does not host QR image files.
An inaccessible or unknown linkId is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR.
Repeating the same user, target URL and title within 5 seconds may return the existing row instead of creating a duplicate.

endpoints.name: Retrieve a QR code
endpoints.summary: Retrieve QR metadata and render its image.
endpoints.description: Returns QR metadata and a freshly rendered PNG data URI using the default image options (512 px, margin 2, ECC M, black on white).

success.description: QR metadata plus the default-rendered image.

notes: Custom colours and size are not persisted; retrieve always renders the defaults.

endpoints.name: Delete a QR code
endpoints.summary: Delete one QR code by id.
endpoints.description: Deletes QR metadata owned by the authenticated developer. The linked short link, if any, is not deleted.

success.description: The id of the deleted QR code.

endpoints.name: QR analytics
endpoints.summary: Read analytics for a QR code, when its link is still available.
endpoints.description: QR scans are not tracked. For a QR created from a short link, this endpoint reports that link's click analytics with tracking set to linked-link-clicks. For a standalone QR code it returns supported: false.

queryParams.name: days
queryParams.description: Number of days in the daily series, ending today. Ignored when supported is false.

success.description: Either linked-link click analytics or an explicit unsupported response.

data.reason: QR scans are not tracked. Create the QR from a short link to see its click analytics.

notes: A standalone QR code always returns supported: false; scans are never counted.
supported: true means the numbers are the linked short link's clicks, not QR scans.
If the linked short link was deleted, the response is supported: false with a reason.

endpoints.name: Analytics overview
endpoints.summary: Read account-level link and QR totals plus a click series.
endpoints.description: Aggregates data LinkFlow already records: link counts, total clicks, QR counts and a per-day click series summed across the developer's links.

queryParams.name: days
queryParams.description: Number of days in the daily series, ending today.

success.description: Account totals, a daily click series and a small recent-QR sample.

notes: totals.clicks is the lifetime sum across all of the developer's links.
daily covers only the requested days and is zero-filled.
mostClickedLink is null when the developer has no links; recentQrCodes contains at most 5 items.
QR scans are not part of this payload; qrCodes counts QR metadata rows.
